123384: The only gem who goes on night patrol. Due to their body producing Mercury (which is harmful to gems and living things), they are isolated and insecure. They hate fighting and hate to be seen.
123385: The main protagonist and the youngest gem when the story began. They're weak, brittle - not suited for battle - and their clumsiness makes them difficult to maintain any roles, even though they've always wanted to be useful.
123386: A gem who works as an expert on the Lunarians. They are studious and passionate about this work, being referred to as a "Lunarian research maniac" by the other gems. They even draw original Lunarian designs sometimes.
123387: A gem who mainly does patrol duty. They are partners with their identical twin, Amethyst 33. The twins work in tandem for most things, often talking at the same time or finishing each other's sentences. No one really cares which is which anymore, including themselves.
123388: A gem who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with Neptunite. Benitoite is a sensible, earnest, and somewhat timid gem who has a hard time saying "no." They're insecure about their lack of individuality.
123389: One of the gems who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with Diamond. Bort is a diamond-class gem whose hardness and toughness are top level. They are a calm yet ruthless warrior who excel at battles and are obsessed with combat. The other gems call them a "battle maniac".
123390: One of the gems who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with Bort. Despite Diamond's high offensive power, their toughness is second-rate and easily broken. The other gems consider them lovely and a top fashion model. Diamond is friendly, kind, and gentle.
123391: A kindly and knowledgeable elder gem who does patrol duty, secretary work, strategy planning, and other odd jobs. They seem to be partners with Jade. Euclase is kind, intellectual, and extremely perceptive.
123392: A gem who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with Morganite. Goshenite is gentle, kind to everyone, and always has a worried expression.
123393: A very serious gem who mainly works as Sensei's spokesperson. They seem to be partners with Euclase. Jade is responsible, hardworking, and takes things too seriously.
123394: Kongou is the teacher of the lustrous. He has a vast amount of knowledge and has the power to drive away the Lunarians with a single attack. Normally, Kongou is quiet and stoic. When he speaks, he is straightforward and concise.
123395: A gem who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with Goshenite. Morganite is overconfident, reckless, and loves to tease Phos.
123396: A reserved, quiet gem who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with Benitoite. Neptunite has a sharp tongue and believes that people should face the truth head-on, regardless of how it makes them feel.
123397: A gem in charge of weapon production. Energetic and bubbly, Obsidian is very dedicated to their job and will make others weapons without hesitation if requested to.
123398: A passionate and dedicated gem in charge of clothing. Red Beryl a workaholic who lives for their job as the fashion stylist and tailor for the other gems. Their style is very frilly, cute, and feminine, and they have a different hairstyle every day.
123399: A gem who works as a doctor. They repair cracked or broken gems and handle the management of herbs, pastes, powders, and other medical remedies. They are partners with the unstable Padparadscha, whose body is actively being maintained.
123400: The oldest gem, who mostly does patrol duty. They're partners with Zircon. Yellow Diamond is cheerful yet mature, and feels responsible for all of their siblings.
123401: One of the gems who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with Yellow Diamond, and they're the second youngest after Phos. Zircon is very hardworking, diligent, and responsible, but is also anxious, always worrying over something.
123994: A gem who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with Watermelon Tourmaline.
123995: A gem who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with Hemimorphite. Watermelon is energetic, bubbly, and always has their head in the clouds. Watermelon is also able to produce an electrical charge, which they are capable of using as an attack.
123996: A sweet, calm, and dedicated elder gem in charge of industrial arts and design. They're partners with Peridot. Sphene used to be partnered with Topaz about a thousand years before the beginning of the story.
123997: One of the elder gems. They're in charge of paper production and are partners with Sphene. Peridot is mature, laid-back, and a little obsessed with making paper. Hemimorphite describes them as "smart and imperturbable".
124215: Brother to Ventricosus, ruler of the Admirabilis.
124307: Antarcticite is the gem assigned to winter duty while the others hibernate. Due to their crystal composition, Antarc "sleeps" in liquid form when it is above room-temperatures, and re-crystallizes when the temperature drops. The colder the temperature, the harder they become.
124485: One of the elder gems who mainly does patrol duty, but is currently inactive. Padparadscha was born with an incomplete torso, which affects their consciousness. They're partners with Rutile, who also maintains their health.
128723: A gem in charge of the library and convalescent center, though they sometimes do patrol duty as well.
209228: A gem who mainly does patrol duty. They are partners with their identical twin, Amethyst 84. The twins work in tandem for most things, often talking at the same time or finishing each other's sentences. No one really cares which is which anymore, including themselves.
318408: A gem that was taken to the moon before the beginning of the story.
393654: A special type of Lunarian that starts out as a giant, towering humanoid with six arms, but when attacked, it divides up into smaller and smaller forms; it eventually splits into 108 adorable, fluffy creatures resembling small dogs.
